name: Matthew Gaidica CV API
description: Static JSON API for the WashU Medicine CV. Fetch cv.json for the full structured record; use profile fields for quick facts.

endpoints.description: Full CV as JSON (profile + structured body from cv.yaml)

agent_notes: Dates prefer MM/YYYY (or MM/YYYY-MM/YYYY / …-present); YYYY or YYYY-YYYY is used when month is unknown. List order is chronological (oldest → newest) within sections.
body[] blocks are section | subsection | bibliography | note | entries.
No auth required. Cache using generated_at or profile.revised.
